main.description: Formatted text, shown like a README.

text.description: Markdown: CommonMark, which readers may extend with common syntax such as GFM tables, task lists and strikethrough. Syntax a reader does not support is shown as plain text. Readers never render raw HTML and keep only http and https links. Each reader chooses how to show a picture in the text, for example as a link, or loaded through its own proxy so the address never learns who reads it.

tableStyle.description: How the tables in the text look. Only the look: a reader that ignores it shows the tables its own way, and the text means the same.

textStyle.description: How blocks of the text are aligned. Only the look: a reader that ignores it shows the text its own way, and the text means the same.

tableStyle.description: Lines of the tables in the text, beside the Markdown and never in it. Each switch left out means the reader's usual lines. A reader that ignores this shows the tables its own way.

hideHeaderLine.description: Hide the line under each table's header row.

hideRowLines.description: Hide the lines between body rows.

showOutline.description: Show a line around each table.

tables.description: Single cell sides, one entry for each table that has them.

tableEdges.description: Single cell sides of one table, shown or hidden whatever the switches say.

lines.description: The block this look was made for: one fingerprint for each of its source lines, in order. A table's delimiter row is left out.

edges.description: Two neighbouring cells share one edge, so each side is stored once. A reader ignores an edge the table has no place for; when two entries name the same edge, the later one counts.

edge.description: One cell side. The top of the cell in row r and column c (rows from 0 with the header as row 0, columns from 0) is horizontal line r, cell c; its bottom is horizontal line r + 1, cell c; its left is vertical line c, cell r; its right is vertical line c + 1, cell r.

direction.description: horizontal: a side between rows; vertical: a side between columns.

line.description: Which grid line, from 0 at the top edge (horizontal) or the left edge (vertical).

cell.description: Which cell along that line: the column for a horizontal line, the row for a vertical one.

hide.description: Hide this side. Left out, the side is shown.

textStyle.description: Alignment of paragraphs, headings and block quotes, beside the Markdown and never in it. A block not listed keeps the reader's start side. A reader that ignores this shows the text its own way.

align.description: One entry for each aligned block.

lines.description: The block this look was made for: one fingerprint for each of its source lines, in order. A table's delimiter row is left out.

value.description: center, or end: the right side in left-to-right text.

lineFingerprint.description: The first 8 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over one source line as UTF-8, with every space and tab removed. Lines end as CommonMark defines. Blocks are read as CommonMark with the GFM table extension only: no math and no footnote extension. A look applies to a top-level block whose lines give exactly these fingerprints, in order, and which ends there: the next line is blank, the end of the text, or the start of another top-level block. Looks with the same fingerprints go to the matching blocks in order; if their numbers differ, none applies.
